decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a high number of low-cost artifacts and creatures, taking advantage of synergy and sacrificing effects to generate value and deal damage efficiently. The use of Affinity cards allows for cheap casting costs and the ability to flood the board with threats, while also maintaining card advantage through draw spells like Thoughtcast. The deck aims to maintain pressure and control the board through a combination of aggressive creatures, removal spells, and synergy between artifacts.

The deck focuses on utilizing artifacts to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and direct damage spells. By combining cheap artifacts with cards that benefit from playing artifacts, such as Myr Enforcer and Thoughtcast, the deck can quickly build a strong board presence while also having access to removal and card draw. The key goal is to establish a quick and efficient offense that can overpower the opponent before they have a chance to recover.

The strategy focuses on quickly building up a powerful creature by enchanting it with multiple auras to make it difficult for opponents to deal with. The deck includes creatures that are hard to target, such as Silhana Ledgewalker and Slippery Bogle, along with a variety of auras to enhance their power and protection. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast, resilient threat that can quickly end the game if left unchecked.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan through counterspells, removal, and card advantage. By using cards like Counterspell, Snuff Out, and Spellstutter Sprite, the deck aims to control the board and prevent the opponent from gaining momentum. The inclusion of card selection spells like Preordain and Brainstorm, along with creatures like Augur of Bolas and Ninja of the Deep Hours, helps ensure that the pilot has access to the necessary tools for each situation. This deck excels at outlasting opponents and gradually grinding out victories.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through countering opponent's spells, destroying creatures, and drawing cards. The deck includes a mix of removal spells like Agony Warp and Cast Down, as well as counter spells like Counterspell and Dispel. It also includes creatures with disruptive abilities like Spellstutter Sprite and Augur of Bolas. The card draw from Deep Analysis and Brainstorm allows the player to maintain card advantage. The deck aims to outlast opponents with control elements while slowly building up board presence and eventually winning the game.

This deck focuses on utilizing sacrifice effects and artifact synergies to control the board and generate value. By sacrificing artifacts like Ichor Wellspring and Refurbished Familiar, you can draw cards and trigger abilities while also fueling cards like Deadly Dispute and Eviscerator's Insight. The combination of removal spells like Cast Down and Snuff Out, along with threats like Nyxborn Hydra and Writhing Chrysalis, allows you to maintain pressure on your opponent while disrupting their game plan. Additionally, cards like Thorn of the Black Rose and Vault of Whispers provide additional utility and card advantage.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly overwhelm your opponent with a combination of cheap, efficient creatures and burn spells. By playing aggressive creatures like Goblin Bushwhacker and Goblin Tomb Raider, along with powerful burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning, you can deal a lot of damage early on and finish off your opponent with a Fireblast. The deck also includes cards like Clockwork Percussionist and Reckless Lackey to help boost your creatures' power and end the game swiftly. Additionally, Kuldotha Rebirth provides additional creature tokens to further pressure your opponent.

The main focus of the deck is to use various sacrifice effects to generate value, while also creating a board state that can quickly overwhelm the opponent. Utilizing cards like Basking Broodscale, Deadly Dispute, and Sadistic Glee, the player can sacrifice creatures for benefits such as card draw or dealing damage. This deck aims to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy while setting up for a powerful combo finish using cards like Writhing Chrysalis and Eviscerator's Insight. The synergy between sacrificing creatures and generating value is key to the deck's success.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by using a combination of countermagic, removal spells, and card advantage through card draw and creature recursion. The deck seeks to disrupt the opponent's game plan while slowly building up its own resources and board presence. It also features some evasive creatures that can pressure the opponent and provide card advantage. The key strategy is to outlast the opponent, control the board, and win through incremental advantage and efficient use of resources.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage. By using cards like Counterspell, Snuff Out, and Dispel to disrupt your opponent's game plan, while generating card advantage with Deep Analysis and Brainstorm, you can slowly take over the game. Augur of Bolas and Spellstutter Sprite provide additional value by acting as both blockers and ways to further disrupt your opponent's spells. The win condition of the deck comes from cards like Murmuring Mystic and Thorn of the Black Rose, allowing you to close out the game once you have firmly established control.

This Mono Blue Aggro deck aims to quickly overwhelm opponents with a mix of evasive creatures like Delver of Secrets and Tolarian Terror, backed up by cheap removal spells and counterspells to protect their creatures. The deck also utilizes card draw and graveyard recursion to maintain a steady stream of threats. The inclusion of a few flexible spells like Artful Dodge and Sleep of the Dead allows for unexpected combat tricks. By utilizing a low land count and a focus on efficient spells, this deck aims to maintain a fast and aggressive tempo throughout the game.

This deck focuses on efficiently and aggressively dealing damage to the opponent using low-cost creatures and spells. By utilizing creature sacrifice and recursion effects, combined with powerful pump spells, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent and control the board. The deck is designed to put pressure on the opponent early in the game and maintain that pressure until victory is achieved. With a focus on synergy and resource management, this Mono Black Aggro deck is built to be fast, relentless, and deadly.

The main focus of this Mono Blue Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with low-cost, evasive creatures and efficient counterspells. By quickly establishing a board presence and disrupting the opponent's plays, this deck aims to control the game tempo and secure victory through consistent pressure and protection. The inclusion of card draw spells helps to maintain card advantage and ensure a steady stream of threats. Overall, this deck is designed to be fast-paced and aggressive, putting the opponent on the back foot from the start.

The main idea of the deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy using low-cost white creatures known as "Weenies". By playing multiple creatures quickly and using cards like Thraben Charm to boost their power, the deck aims to quickly build a strong board presence and deal damage efficiently. Cards like Guardians' Pledge and Battle Screech can provide additional power and tokens to further pressure the opponent. The deck also includes some card draw and protection spells to maintain tempo and control the game.

The main focus of this Aggro-Affinity deck is to quickly deploy artifact creatures and utilize cheap removal spells and card draw to aggressively overwhelm the opponent. By efficiently casting spells like Galvanic Blast and Thoughtcast, while maximizing the benefits of artifacts like Myr Enforcer and Reckoner's Bargain, this deck aims to maintain a fast pace and pressure the opponent into making suboptimal plays. With a mix of direct damage, card advantage, and creature synergy, this deck is designed to swiftly close out games and disrupt the opponent's plans.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling an aggressive board presence through efficient artifact creatures like Myr Enforcer and Reckoner's Bargain, supported by cards like Galvanic Blast for removal and Drossforge Bridge for additional artifact summoning. The strategy revolves around using artifacts to gain advantage with cards like Ichor Wellspring and Mistvault Bridge, while also disrupting opponents with cards like Nihil Spellbomb and Krark-Clan Shaman. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of aggressive creatures and strategic removal, leveraging its synergy with artifact-based abilities.
